v4.6.95 — Cloud start no longer fails when the connection drops during IBKR boot

🛰️ THE FIX (DAY, breakout, and every current/future bot)
• An IBKR cold start boots the gateway on Oracle (login + API init, up to ~90s) DURING the start request, so the network sometimes resets the connection mid-boot — which used to show as a red “Cloud start failed: Connection aborted / 10054”. But the server keeps booting the gateway and starts the bot anyway.
• Now, if the start connection drops, the app no longer declares failure: it waits and polls the bot’s status for up to ~2 min until the gateway is up and the bot reports running. You’ll see “Connection dropped during start — but the gateway keeps booting… Waiting…” then “Gateway is up — bot is running.”
• Genuine errors (missing keys, unknown bot) still surface immediately. The server start is idempotent + lock-serialised, so this recovery is always safe.

Update via the in-app banner.
